front: Operations run by predictive optimization
back: OPTIMIZE, VACUUM, ANALYZE and REFRESH INDEX on Unity Catalog managed tables, on serverless jobs compute. Không chạy ZORDER và không chạy trên external table.

front: Scope syntax for predictive optimization
back: `ALTER CATALOG | SCHEMA | TABLE ... ENABLE | DISABLE | INHERIT PREDICTIVE OPTIMIZATION`. Object con kế thừa từ account, catalog, schema.

front: Requirements for CLUSTER BY AUTO
back: Unity Catalog managed table, predictive optimization enabled, DBR 15.4 LTS+. External table chỉ dùng được clustering key thủ công.

front: Maximum number of liquid clustering keys
back: 4. Với table dưới 10 TB, nhiều key hơn làm filter một cột chậm hơn.

front: Effect of ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY (new keys) on existing data
back: Existing data is not rewritten; run `OPTIMIZE ... FULL` to recluster. Write và OPTIMIZE sau đó dùng key mới.

front: Convert a partitioned Delta table to liquid clustering in place
back: `ALTER TABLE t REPLACE PARTITIONED BY WITH CLUSTER BY (...)` on DBR 18.1+, then OPTIMIZE. Partition column trở thành hierarchical clustering key.

front: What deletion vectors speed up
back: DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE, by marking changed rows instead of rewriting whole Parquet files. Row cũ chỉ bị xoá vật lý khi file được rewrite.

front: Physically remove soft-deleted rows
back: `REORG TABLE t APPLY (PURGE)`, then VACUUM after the retention period. Dùng cho yêu cầu xoá vĩnh viễn data.

ref.label: Remove unused data files with vacuum

front: Disk cache vs Spark cache: which is automatic?
back: Disk cache (formerly Delta cache): automatic, local SSD, Parquet only, self-invalidating. Spark cache cần `cache()` trong code và áp cho mọi DataFrame.

front: CACHE SELECT on SQL warehouses and DBR 14.2+
back: Ignored; an enhanced disk caching algorithm is used instead. Đề nhắc CACHE SELECT thường là distractor.

front: Legacy vs automatic change data feed on DBR 19+
back: Automatic CDF computes changes at read time from row tracking (Delta) or row lineage (Iceberg v3), with no per-table setting; Databricks recommends migrating from legacy. Một table không dùng cả hai loại.

front: `_change_type` values in change data feed
back: insert, update_preimage, update_postimage, delete. Một UPDATE sinh 2 row preimage và postimage.

front: First run of a streaming read with readChangeFeed and no starting version
back: Returns the current table snapshot as insert records, then subsequent changes. Đặt `startingVersion` nếu target đã có data tới version đó.

front: Automatic change data feed requirements
back: DBR 19+, Unity Catalog table: Delta with row tracking or managed Iceberg v3. Không cần bật từng table, không dùng chung với legacy CDF.

front: Query profile insight DATA_SPILL
back: Data did not fit in memory and spilled to disk; increase warehouse size or reduce rows and columns. Đọc ở tab Performance insights.

front: Who can view a query profile?
back: The query owner, or a user with at least CAN MONITOR on the SQL warehouse. Query trả từ query cache không có profile.

front: AQE runtime broadcast threshold on Databricks
back: `spark.databricks.adaptive.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold`, default 30MB. AQE đổi sort merge join sang broadcast hash join lúc chạy.

front: Partitioning guidance by table size
back: Under 1 TB: don't partition. 1 to 100 TB: liquid clustering. 100 TB+: liquid first, partition only if verified; each partition at least 1 GB.

front: Autotuned target file size for UC managed tables
back: 256 MB under 2.56 TB, growing linearly to 1 GB at 10 TB, 1 GB above. Đặt `delta.targetFileSize` để cố định.

front: Query a measure in a metric view
back: Wrap it in `MEASURE()` and group by fields, e.g. `SELECT Segment, MEASURE(Revenue) FROM mv GROUP BY ALL`. Không dùng `SELECT *`.

front: Predictive optimization VACUUM when `delta.deletedFileRetentionDuration` is below 7 days
back: It still retains data files for at least 7 days. Muốn xoá sớm hơn thì không dựa vào Predictive Optimization.

front: Recluster only part of a liquid table after a key change
back: `OPTIMIZE t FULL WHERE <predicate>` on DBR 18.1+; files whose range overlaps the predicate are reclustered. Tránh rewrite cả table lớn.

front: CREATE OR REPLACE on a table with CLUSTER BY AUTO
back: Without `CLUSTER BY AUTO` in the statement, automatic clustering is turned off and selected keys are lost. Luôn lặp lại `CLUSTER BY AUTO` khi replace.

front: Caching APIs on serverless compute
back: `df.cache()` and `persist()` work; `CACHE TABLE`, `spark.catalog.cacheTable()`, `clearCache()` and `df.checkpoint()` throw exceptions. Notebook chuyển từ classic sang serverless hay lỗi ở đây.

front: Performance insight EXCESSIVE_QUEUE_TIME
back: Queries wait in the warehouse queue; increase the maximum number of clusters (scale out). Tăng size chỉ giúp `DATA_SPILL`.

front: Metric view materialization: when does a query use it?
back: Exact match, rollup match for additive measures, or unaggregated match; otherwise it reads the source. Measure non-additive như `COUNT(DISTINCT)` cần exact match.
